name: Odie Sheet Metal
old_description: From prototype development to running production-volume orders, here at Odie Sheet Metal, we've got you covered. We can provide high-precision prototypes as well as high-quality production runs to your specifications. You see, we've been in the business since 1979 and we've got the experience that it takes to be the best.
about:
Odie Sheet Metal has operated from San Jose, California since 1979. The company was founded over four decades ago and continues to serve the region from its facility on Umbarger Road.

The shop specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication, taking projects from prototype development through production-volume runs. In-house capabilities include welding, forming, plating, painting, and silk-screening, allowing finished parts to leave the facility complete. The company emphasizes that no job is too small, accommodating both one-off prototypes and larger production quantities.

While the company does not list specific industry sectors, its fabrication services support customers needing custom metal enclosures, brackets, chassis, and similar components. The broad process suite suggests work for electronics, industrial equipment, and general manufacturing clients, though no named customers or verticals appear in public materials.

Odie Sheet Metal points to its longevity and experienced staff as its primary differentiators, noting that the team has been in the business since 1979 and brings that depth to every project. The combination of prototype agility and full finishing services under one roof is presented as a convenience for buyers who would otherwise coordinate multiple vendors.
